notes: Independent reader r1 of scan 29/036 only. C and H are witnesses, not authorities; all live wording was compared against the viewed ink. No other page or reader output was accessed.

Twenty-seven physical typed baseline rows form two paragraphs. The two interlinear additions are not counted as extra baseline rows. Approximate line references in this report use those physical rows; content identifies places where older C notes number them differently.

Content description: the document claims that, with a connectedness condition, the category under discussion is described by a profinite fundamental group of (Z,G), extending G by the fundamental group of Z. It explains a role for normality in full faithfulness and invokes descent for a principal covering. The second paragraph introduces multiple ramification models, local models and a compatibility condition. These are reported claims, not independently verified theorems.

No mathematical proof check, independent re-proof or computation was performed. Mathematical grammar did not supply either missing relation sign. The comparison meaning of worse was not used to choose between the s/r overprints.

Literal unusual forms retained: developped; pther; catégory; twp, On. Doubtful unusual forms retained: classifind|classified, wosse|worse, modals|models. The only new candidate added is befause, because the third letter of because includes a high f-like stroke.

The final letters of connectedness, fixed, interested, of and worse are affected by right-edge clipping. The doubtful full-word candidates are explicitly marked and are not claimed as wholly visible letter sequences.

The cancelled material consists of one word, one internal letter, one two-letter fragment, and one phrase. Readable contents are retained. Several other letters have superposed strokes; no recoverable cancellation chronology is invented for because, wosse, modals/models or given.

In the shared crop for modals/models and given, both adjacent unresolved places were inspected once. The fourth vowel of the former remains ambiguous. The live letters given can be recognized; superposed residual marks around gi do not establish a separate cancelled word.
The actual empty intervals in the functor expression and between U and V were settled at the half-image readings and therefore were not cropped again.

Two single underlines are preserved. H emph is treated as encoding the same visible emphasis, and H struck/ill are compared on content and state rather than macro names. No typography-only macro differences are counted.

There is no heading, title, date, signature, stamp, displayed formula, drawing or diagram on this scan. The lower-left pencil number 35 is an archive number, not an authorial manuscript page number; it is retained only in a comment.

Actual viewing record: one whole image, one view of each original-resolution half, twelve tight enlarged crops each viewed once. All twelve crops use the original whole image, Pillow LANCZOS to 2600 pixels wide, and autocontrast; no sharpening or rotation. No OCR, text extraction, recognition library, internet, external text or other page was used.
